subject: Quick note about Friday draft
text: I want to make sure everyone sees the same notes before Friday's deadline, so I summarized the reading into a shorter outline and dropped it in the shared folder. I did not change the professor's questions, only added small prompts that might help us compare ideas without drifting into a summary of each chapter. My main concern is timing. We have less than two days to draft, exchange feedback, and revise, which means we should decide today whether each section will be completed independently or worked through during our evening call. I can draft the introduction if someone else wants to handle the discussion examples, but I would prefer not to leave the conclusion until the final night. If anyone is stuck on the rubric, please ask here rather than spending an hour rereading the assignment sheet. That may save time for the actual revisions. Also, if one of us has to miss the call because of work, please let the group know in advance so we can reassign the part that still needs comments. I will also leave timestamps on the sources we quote, because citation formatting always takes longer than it seems, and I would rather protect our grade than rush it late. Does that work for you?
